resources.label: FEED FUND
resources.limit: Protected obligations are unavailable for discretionary spending.
resources.source: Sound and golden claim credit, fulfilled Mutual binders, and filed awards.
resources.strategic_value: Liquidity for surviving this shift and choosing the next one.
resources.use: Feed, payroll, facilities, resolutions, procurement, and capital.

resources.label: PROTECTED RESERVE
resources.limit: Not spendable and released only as obligations settle.
resources.source: Derived from payroll, upkeep, feed, breach exposure, arrears, and debt.
resources.strategic_value: Turns solvency into a visible constraint instead of a surprise.
resources.use: Prevents a purchase from silently consuming already-promised money.

resources.label: TREASURY HEADROOM
resources.limit: Interest accrues and an exhausted indebted line freezes capital.
resources.source: Farm Mutual standing and a debt-free close record.
resources.strategic_value: Recovery time after a weak close without making failure free.
resources.use: Automatically bridges vendors and interest, never flock wages.

resources.label: FEED STOCK
resources.limit: Finite bins and dated lots create capacity and spoilage risk.
resources.source: One disclosed provisions order during eligible closing review.
resources.strategic_value: Hedge price pressure or buy fresher, kinder feed.
resources.use: Covers the flock's next ration before seasonal spot buying.

resources.label: FARM MUTUAL STANDING
resources.limit: Standard-book days are neutral; breaches also break clean streaks.
resources.source: Two points per fulfilled binder, minus one per breach.
resources.strategic_value: Long-run client access earned by reliable claim handling.
resources.use: Gates Service Coop tiers, negotiation, and Treasury capacity.

resources.label: LIVE-FILE CAPACITY
resources.limit: Storage does not add workers; excess demand is turned away.
resources.source: Records facilities and commissioned routing infrastructure.
resources.strategic_value: Captures opportunity only when staffing and routing can clear it.
resources.use: Holds accepted claims and creates room for disclosed binder arrivals.

strategies.counterweight: Strain, cracks, rework, payroll, and welfare scrutiny rise if pushed blindly.
strategies.label: THROUGHPUT ROOST
strategies.lever: Route specialties, Priority Peck, overtime, and packing capacity.
strategies.upside: Clear more sound claims before deadlines and capture busy-book demand.

strategies.counterweight: Slower handling can create overdue files and rejected demand.
strategies.label: SHELL ASSURANCE
strategies.lever: Favor careful routing, shell checks, training, and deliberate rework.
strategies.upside: Protect golden credit, clean streaks, standing, and binder settlement.

strategies.counterweight: Immediate expense and gentler targets may slow capital accumulation.
strategies.label: FLOCK STEWARDSHIP
strategies.lever: Choose kinder feed, humane doctrine, recovery time, and care facilities.
strategies.upside: Sustain morale, lower grievances, and preserve long-run productive capacity.

strategies.counterweight: Breach reserves, clauses, and demand spikes make overcommitment expensive.
strategies.label: MUTUAL SPECIALIST
strategies.lever: Build standing, negotiate riders, and selectively bind seasonal claim books.
strategies.upside: Earn premiums, outside files, and better Service Coop access.

strategies.counterweight: Every idle perch and service adds recurring cost before it earns anything.
strategies.label: CAPACITY BUILDER
strategies.lever: Commission Records, desks, managers, facilities, campus, and portfolio services.
strategies.upside: Raise file, staffing, and processing ceilings for later books.
